name: Luke
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry. So whatever contention Paul and Barnabas had over Mark, it was resolved, because he says Mark is profitable. Something changed.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride
